_comment: REFACTOR_PLAN.md section 4, phase 2 then phase 4: documents, per EntityKind, what bridge/perception.py's already-existing functions actually compute. Odour is a list of labelled channels (not a scalar) so a Goomba and a Koopa CAN smell different once code exists that tells them apart. Phase 4 gave KindRegistry real GOOMBA/KOOPA kinds (docs/ENTITIES.md's phase 4 report has the empirical survey) and this file now gives them DISTINCT channels ('threat_goomba'/'threat_koopa') -- discrimination is now POSSIBLE, not switched on: bridge/perception.py's goomba_odor still sums every non-powerup entity into one undifferentiated aversive signal regardless of species, and this file's own gain/hunger numbers stay hand-set scalars in config/params.py (CLAUDE.md invariant 3, docs/SCALARS.md). Making the channels here the runtime source of a per-species aggregate is a live-behaviour change (phase 6's own eligibility-trace territory), not this phase's to make silently.

GOOMBA._note: ADDR_ENEMY_TYPE==0x06, screenshot-verified (docs/ENTITIES.md phase 4): 1-1's iconic first enemy. Distinct channel from KOOPA's -- not yet read by any live aggregation, which still treats every non-powerup entity as one 'threat' class regardless of this file.

KOOPA._note: ADDR_ENEMY_TYPE==0x00, screenshot-verified in 1-2's underground section (docs/ENTITIES.md phase 4) -- corroborates sprint 010's own manual RAM-inspection identification of the same byte as 'Green Koopa Troopa'. Distinct channel from GOOMBA's, same not-yet-live caveat.

ENEMY._note: The fallback for any active, non-powerup enemy slot whose ADDR_ENEMY_TYPE isn't GOOMBA or KOOPA -- Piranha Plant and whatever else SMB's later levels contain, not yet identified by this project (docs/ENTITIES.md phase 4's survey covered only as much of 1-1/1-2 as a real or bot-driven playthrough could reach). Kept generic and undifferentiated rather than guessed.

POWERUP._note: mushroom/flower/star/1-up, one RAM type byte (0x2E), never distinguished from each other.

QUESTION_BLOCK._note: Tile-based, not an enemy-slot entity -- bridge/perception.py's question_block_odor reads tile_ram directly rather than mario.entities.registry, a deliberate phase-2 scoping decision (docs/ENTITIES.md). Shares the 'food' channel with POWERUP because run_steering.py's main() sums them before applying ODOUR_GAIN/hunger -- this file documents that equivalence, it doesn't create it.

USED_BLOCK._note: A question block after it's been hit -- solid, nothing left to smell (tile_ram.USED_BLOCK_ID is excluded from QUESTION_IDS by construction).

SOLID_OTHER._note: Bricks, pipes, anything else tile_ram.solid_ahead treats as a wall. Pipe metatile IDs (0x10-0x15) are confirmed in tile_ram.py's own docstring but never given a separate kind -- folded in here, undifferentiated, exactly as the climb reflex already treats them.

PIT._note: Synthesised from a run of EMPTY ground tiles, not read from a RAM slot. mario.entities.registry.KindRegistry.pit_record() builds a real EntityRecord for it; not yet a call site in main()'s decision loop (docs/ENTITIES.md).
